cannot_statement: Adding ordinary morphology detail cannot be treated as sufficient to recover the missing Hebrew context-conditioned consequence.
eligibility_reason: This rejects a specific bridge representation.
evidence_ceiling: Simple morphology refinement is not the missing bridge between Hebrew and glyph context conditioning. Prohibited inferences: morphology is irrelevant

cannot_statement: The missing Hebrew context interaction cannot be recovered merely by changing among the tested recurrence-based consequence definitions.
consequence_signature: all primary Hebrew interaction gates remain failed
eligibility_reason: This constrains recurrence as the outcome representation.
evidence_ceiling: The missing Hebrew interaction is not recovered by the tested recurrence-based consequence representations. Prohibited inferences: Hebrew has no structural consequence

cannot_statement: On the glyph side, the immediate outgoing structural state cannot be specified independently of operator and context together; the tested Hebrew representation cannot be assumed to share that same profile.
eligibility_reason: The glyph-system dependency is direct; the cross-system identity claim remains rejected.
evidence_ceiling: Glyph structure contains context-conditioned immediate-transition information, but the tested Hebrew representation does not mirror that profile. Prohibited inferences: glyph and Hebrew operations are identical; zero profile correlation rules out deeper abstraction

cannot_statement: A documentary/unit boundary cannot be treated as equivalent to the substantive end state of a trajectory when it frequently censors observation before a departure occurs.
consequence_signature: outcome becomes censored rather than known
eligibility_reason: This is an observation-boundary constraint, not proof that the process continues.
evidence_ceiling: The tested first-passage interaction is not predictive, and unit boundaries materially censor the observation process. Prohibited inferences: long-range structure is absent; unit boundary is a substantive state

cannot_statement: Real verse adjacency cannot be assumed to carry a special structural continuation relation under the tested representation because it does not outperform matched shuffled continuation.
eligibility_reason: Negative for the tested structural continuation signal.
evidence_ceiling: The tested structural representation does not recover a special verse-to-verse continuation relation. Prohibited inferences: canonical sequence is random

cannot_statement: Real continuation cannot be treated as privileged over shuffled continuation even under disjoint-book control in this representation.
consequence_signature: real is matched or beaten by shuffle
eligibility_reason: This strengthens the representation-level null without proving absence of all long-range order.
evidence_ceiling: The tested continuation effect does not survive a stronger disjoint-book control. Prohibited inferences: all long-range dependence is absent

cannot_statement: The tested context-interaction term cannot be treated as the rule selecting among competing resolution branches.
eligibility_reason: The experiment points toward a different resolution architecture.
evidence_ceiling: The tested context interaction does not explain which competing resolution occurs. Prohibited inferences: resolution has no structure

cannot_statement: Current state under the tested encoding cannot by itself specify a transferable next-operator grammar.
eligibility_reason: The failure is representation-specific; operator choice need not be random.
evidence_ceiling: The tested state representation is insufficient to determine a transferable next-operator grammar. Prohibited inferences: operator choice is random

cannot_statement: Local full-morph structure cannot be treated as independent of distance from the masked operator position; a reproducible proximal footprint remains.
consequence_signature: state distribution changes near the masked position
eligibility_reason: This is a location/temporal dependency, but not yet operator-identity specific.
evidence_ceiling: A masked operator position is associated with a short-range structural footprint in full morphology. Prohibited inferences: operator causally creates the footprint; all operator identities share one footprint

cannot_statement: The proximal footprint cannot be attributed specifically to operator identity on the evidence of V29 alone; matched operator substitution does not reproduce a selective local perturbation.
consequence_signature: proximal effect is not selectively altered
eligibility_reason: This narrows the eligible law from operator-specific to position/context-dependent.
evidence_ceiling: V29's short-range footprint is not shown to be specific to operator identity by this intervention. Prohibited inferences: V29 footprint is false

cannot_statement: Glyph physical-form class cannot be treated as sufficient to specify complete neighboring Hebrew morphology.
eligibility_reason: This rejects a complete-state decoding claim while leaving lower-dimensional alignment open.
evidence_ceiling: Glyph physical form does not specify complete neighboring morphology under V35-P. Prohibited inferences: glyph form carries no structural information

cannot_statement: The cross-modal relation cannot be reduced to complete state identity when glyph form carries more reliable information about transition direction than full morphology.
eligibility_reason: This is a post-result synthesis preserved from V35-P.
evidence_ceiling: Computer-readable glyph form aligns with the direction of local Hebrew morphological transition more reliably than with full neighboring state identity. Prohibited inferences: glyphs generate Hebrew; directional signal is universal

cannot_statement: Unseen observations cannot be forced into the already learned family vocabulary without violating the frozen acceptance envelope; abstention is required for out-of-envelope cases.
eligibility_reason: This directly argues against a closed vocabulary, but family labels remain representations.
evidence_ceiling: Some structural family organization transfers to unseen real-corpus observations without forcing every observation into a known family. Prohibited inferences: family inventory is complete; abstention means no structure

cannot_statement: Cross-source recurrence cannot be preserved when within-observation spatial topology is destroyed while identities and grayscale statistics are held fixed.
eligibility_reason: This is one of the strongest demonstrations that relational arrangement is necessary to the observed recurrence.
evidence_ceiling: The recurring structure depends materially on spatial topology, not only on marginal visual statistics. Prohibited inferences: all topology features are equally important

cannot_statement: Failure of later transfer cannot be blamed on inability of the instrument to recover the deliberately planted white-paint grammar; under controlled conditions it recovers the planted rules.
eligibility_reason: This validates measurement capacity but says nothing directly about natural law.
evidence_ceiling: The measurement system can recover the deliberately planted white-paint graph grammar under controlled conditions. Prohibited inferences: the white-paint grammar is universal; physical marks obey the planted grammar

cannot_statement: The calibrated white-paint grammar cannot be transferred wholesale to the glyph-proxy corpus; only selected structural dimensions survive.
consequence_signature: some predictions pass and others fail
eligibility_reason: A whole grammar is too coarse a unit of universality.
evidence_ceiling: Only a subset of the calibrated graph grammar generalizes to the glyph-proxy corpus. Prohibited inferences: white-paint grammar is a universal operator system

cannot_statement: The white-paint grammar cannot be transferred wholesale to physical witnesses; repetition-degree partly survives while closure and the full grammar do not.
eligibility_reason: This motivates law-by-law rather than grammar-by-grammar comparison.
evidence_ceiling: Some graph-level recurrence structure survives into physical witnesses, but the white-paint grammar as a whole does not transfer cleanly. Prohibited inferences: physical systems instantiate one known grammar; appearance differences are merely noise

cannot_statement: The early cross-source recurrence cannot be explained by the frozen null worlds that destroy the relevant spatial/structural organization.
eligibility_reason: The observed recurrence depends on organized physical structure before semantics.
evidence_ceiling: Cross-source physical recurrence was detectable above the early frozen null worlds before semantic interpretation. Prohibited inferences: recurrence proves shared meaning; early family inventory is complete

cannot_statement: A learned structural family vocabulary cannot be assumed closed: unseen observations may remain lawfully outside all known family envelopes rather than being forced into a class.
eligibility_reason: This is a representation-vocabulary constraint.
evidence_ceiling: A recurring structural vocabulary can transfer partially while leaving genuinely unclassified observations outside known families. Prohibited inferences: closed finite family vocabulary is justified; abstentions are noise

cannot_statement: Incoming Hebrew structural state alone cannot specify the immediate outgoing-state distribution; current operator identity contributes additional information.

evidence_ceiling: Hebrew operator identity contributes immediate-transition information beyond incoming state even though the tested context interaction does not. Prohibited inferences: Hebrew and glyph interaction profiles match; operator has fixed semantics

cannot_statement: For the tested downstream trajectory, neither operator nor context alone can be assumed to contain all predictive information; both contribute, while the tested explicit interaction is not the correct complete combination rule.
